question.text: The PM's written policy on order placement must specify ALL of the following EXCEPT:

answer.text: Situations requiring individual vs pooled orders
Scenarios permitting deviation from intended allocation
How margins/collaterals are segregated across clients
The PM's family tree for three generations

explanation.text: The Logic: Policies cover order-placement, allocation deviations, and margin segregation. Family trees are not required. The Trap: The bizarre distractor should stand out — regulation requires real operational detail. Cross-Exam Context: Same governance content in III-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Board-approved policies must be dated, versioned and reviewed annually.
